page.title: Orders and payment reconciliation
page.heading: Orders and payment reconciliation
page.introduction: Manual checks use the merchant configuration saved with each order. Before closing an order, the system checks its payment status and releases a pending order only after the payment provider confirms closure.
close.title: Confirm closing pending order
close.warning: A closed unpaid order can no longer be paid. If payment has already arrived, the system will verify and preserve the payment result.
review.title: Resolve payment review
review.introduction: Retrying fulfillment checks payment with the provider. Case closure is determined from confirmed payment, refund, and license records. Resolve pending refunds first.
review.payment_label: Payment to retry (used only when retrying fulfillment)
refund.form_legend: Request refund to original payment method
refund.impact_note: Partial refunds keep the license active. After the receipt linked to a license is fully refunded and confirmed, the license is revoked and client sessions are invalidated.
refund_review.title: Manual refund review
refund_review.introduction: A refund can be cancelled only if it has not been sent and no task is running. Query-only mode keeps the reserved amount and continues checking the provider. Automatic mode can retry with the original refund number.
refund_review.cancel_unsent: Cancel unsent refund and release reservation
finance.fulfillment_existing: A license fulfillment record already exists; it cannot be issued again.
finance.fulfillment_missing: No license fulfillment record exists for this order.
finance.no_payment_available: No payment receipt is available to retry fulfillment.
message.provider_uncertain: The provider has not returned a conclusive result. The order is unchanged; try again later.
message.operation_incomplete: The operation is incomplete. Refresh and check again.
refund.title: {channel} refunds and history
refund.wallet_help: Wallet payments are returned to the original currency balance. They cannot be converted to cash or another payment method.
refund.wechat_help: Request a refund to the original WeChat receipt. Enter the order amount; discounts may make the cash refund differ. The provider result is authoritative.
refund.alipay_help: Request a refund to the original Alipay receipt.
refund.check_amount: Check the actual payment receipt and refundable amount.
refund.none_verified: This order has no verified payment and cannot be refunded.
refund.amount_invalid: Enter an amount within the refundable limit, using no more than two decimal places.
refund.success_wallet: The refund was returned to the original currency wallet balance.
refund.success_pending: The refund request was saved for processing and provider verification. Refund success is not yet confirmed.
error.default: The operation is incomplete. Refresh and check again.
error.permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.
error.order_not_in_review: The order is no longer under review. Refresh and check again.
error.payment_review_input_invalid: Check the resolution method, payment receipt, and reason.
error.payment_review_refunds_pending: Unresolved refunds remain. Check their results first.
error.payment_review_receipts_unresolved: Additional receipts have not been fully refunded; the case cannot be closed or fulfilled.
error.payment_review_cannot_fulfill: A license, refund, or fulfillment record already exists; duplicate fulfillment is blocked.
error.account_restricted_or_unverified: The account is restricted or its contact information is unverified; fulfillment is blocked.
error.payment_review_platform_unconfirme: The provider has not confirmed this payment. The order remains under review.
error.payment_review_evidence_invalid: Payment evidence does not match. The order remains under review.
error.alipay_identity_mismatch: The merchant identity or currency does not match. The order remains under review.
error.refund_pending: This receipt has a refund awaiting review. Resolve that refund first.
error.refund_review_terminal: A completed or cancelled refund cannot be changed again.
error.refund_review_busy: A refund task is running. Wait for its check to finish before reviewing.
error.refund_already_attempted: A refund request was already sent, so its reservation cannot be released. Query-only mode is available.
error.refund_review_mode_unchanged: This review mode is already active. Refresh and check again.
error.refund_review_evidence_invalid: Refund and order amounts do not match. The refund remains under review.
error.refund_review_input_invalid: Check the refund review action and reason.
error.refund_review_confirmation_require: Review and confirm the refund decision first.
error.order_not_refundable: This order cannot currently be refunded. Refresh and check again.
error.wallet_purchase_not_found: The matching original wallet debit was not found. Check the ledger first.
error.wallet_refund_history_mismatch: Wallet refund records do not match. Check the ledger first.
error.wallet_balance_limit: The returned amount would exceed the balance limit. Ask finance to review it.
error.wallet_recharge_refund_insufficien: The recharge balance is insufficient for a refund. Check the spent balance first.
error.refund_amount_exceeded: The refund total exceeds the refundable amount. Refresh and check again.
error.idempotency_conflict: This refund number is already associated with different data. Review it again.
error.refund_input_invalid: Check the refund amount, reason, and payment receipt.
error.alipay_refund_mismatch: Provider refund details do not match. The refund remains under review; contact finance.
error.payment_fulfillment_review_require: The historical payment-to-license association is unclear and requires manual review.
error.order_not_cancellable: The order state changed and it cannot be closed. Refresh and check again.
error.alipay_transport_unknown: The provider response is uncertain. The original state is preserved; check again later.
error.alipay_close_unknown: No conclusive closure result is available. The order is preserved; retry later.
error.alipay_payment_mismatch: Provider transaction details do not match the order. Contact finance.
error.payment_attempt_not_found: The original order merchant snapshot was not found. Contact the system administrator.
error.wechat_order_busy: The original order is generating a QR code or checking closure. Try again later.
error.wechat_close_unknown: WeChat closure is not confirmed. The order is preserved; check again later.
error.wechat_provider_unknown: The WeChat response is uncertain. Try again later.
error.wechat_payment_mismatch: The WeChat transaction does not match the order or merchant. It remains under review.
error.wechat_signature_invalid: WeChat response signature verification failed. Contact the system administrator.
error.wechat_refund_mismatch: WeChat refund details do not match the original receipt. The refund remains under review.
error.wechat_refund_conflict: WeChat refund confirmation records conflict. Contact finance.
error.wechat_transport_unknown: The WeChat request result is uncertain. Check the original refund later; do not submit it again.
error.refund_lease_lost: Another task is processing this refund. Refresh and check again.
error.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
